overview: Markets: Sensex fell for a fourth session to near 71,910, rupee slid to 96.11/dollar and Brent oil jumped past $100.
Big story: Israeli strikes killed several in Gaza and a building collapse trapped dozens as the ceasefire unravels.

items.headline: Israeli strikes kill several in Gaza as ceasefire unravels
items.summary: Israeli attacks killed at least eight Palestinians in Gaza, including a journalist, while a building collapse in Gaza City trapped dozens under rubble. The violence marks a sharp escalation of ceasefire violations nearly a year after a US-brokered truce, deepening doubts about Israel's international standing.

items.headline: Pentagon data breach exposes 2.8 million military personnel
items.summary: Hackers stole personal data, including Social Security numbers and job details, from roughly 2.8 million current and former US military personnel in a months-long breach. The Department of Defense confirmed the intrusion exploited a file-sharing system vulnerability, renewing scrutiny of Pentagon cybersecurity.

items.headline: Morocco appoints Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri as first woman PM
items.summary: King Mohammed VI named Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri as Morocco's first female prime minister, a week after her Authenticity and Modernity Party won parliamentary elections. The former Marrakesh mayor called it a historic day for women, becoming only the third female head of government in the Arab world.

items.headline: France hit by nationwide public-sector strikes and protests
items.summary: Hundreds of thousands of teachers, healthcare workers and firefighters joined coordinated strikes across France over pay and austerity measures, forcing school closures and flight disruptions at major airports. Unions have already scheduled further walkouts by energy and pension-sector workers in early October.

items.headline: Brazil's Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro locked in dead heat before vote
items.summary: President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing challenger Flavio Bolsonaro are running neck and neck days before Brazil's first-round presidential vote on October 4. Polling shows the race within the margin of error, with a runoff likely if neither clears 50% of valid votes.

items.headline: Flydubai pilot hailed hero after mid-air stabbing, emergency landing
items.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu praised Indian pilot Captain Smit Machchhar for saving 174 passengers after a stabbing aboard a Tel Aviv-bound Flydubai flight forced an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia. Flydubai has since halted flights to Israel following the incident.

items.headline: Israel says Iran is renewing nuclear progress despite talks
items.summary: Netanyahu presented the UAE's president with intelligence alleging Iran is renewing nuclear work at a mountainous site, even as Qatari mediators push a proposal to Tehran and Iran's president denies any bomb ambitions. The standoff complicates US efforts to broker a wider regional deal.

items.headline: Colombia's central bank surprises markets with rate hike to 12.25%
items.summary: Colombia's central bank unexpectedly raised its policy rate to 12.25% on the same day jobless data showed a 9.4% unemployment rate, as the government separately seeks IMF assistance. The move signals policymakers are prioritising inflation control over growth support.

items.headline: Hurricane Rachel pulls away from Mexico's Pacific coast
items.summary: Hurricane Rachel moved away from mainland Mexico after threatening coastal states, easing immediate fears of major landfall damage. Forecasters continued to monitor the storm's track as it heads further out into the Pacific.

items.headline: Bangladesh MP resigns after clinic-attack scandal
items.summary: An MP known as Mishti resigned her reserved parliamentary seat on orders from the prime minister's office following scrutiny over an attack at the Radda clinic. She is also expected to resign from the ruling party as the fallout continues.

items.headline: Bangladesh's ruling BNP dissolves Dhaka North leadership committee
items.summary: Bangladesh's Nationalist Party dissolved its 51-member Dhaka North city convening committee after earlier expelling several unit leaders over alleged anti-organisational activity. The shake-up comes as BNP steps up activity amid opposition programmes led by Jamaat-e-Islami.

items.headline: South Korea, Japan foreign ministers pledge closer cooperation
items.summary: South Korea's Foreign Minister Cho Hyun called for stronger trilateral cooperation between Seoul, Tokyo and Beijing to promote regional peace and prosperity. The statement comes amid continued diplomatic sensitivities across Northeast Asia.

items.headline: Taiwan's president moved to secure site during military drill
items.summary: Taiwan President Lai Ching-te was taken in an armoured personnel carrier to a secure facility during a military exercise in Taipei, underscoring heightened defence preparedness. The drill came as security researchers reported one of the first known fully autonomous AI-driven cyberattacks on Taiwanese government agencies.

items.headline: Supreme Court: judges shouldn't impose personal morality in bail pleas
items.summary: A Supreme Court bench of Justices Ujjal Bhuyan and Atul Chandurkar said judges must not let personal views on morality influence bail or criminal trial decisions, while setting aside a Madhya Pradesh High Court order that had denied bail in a case involving a minor. The ruling reinforces objective legal standards in sensitive cases.

items.headline: Supreme Court hears TMC plea on ED-frozen bank accounts
items.summary: The Supreme Court heard a plea by the All India Trinamool Congress seeking permission to operate four bank accounts frozen by the Enforcement Directorate, alongside Congress leader Pawan Khera's challenge to criminal proceedings over remarks about the Prime Minister. Both matters reflect ongoing friction between opposition parties and central agencies.

items.headline: Opposition renews calls for Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to resign
items.summary: India's opposition parties stepped up demands for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to resign, accusing the BJP of manipulating voter lists during the ongoing electoral roll revision. The opposition is preparing nationwide protests, deepening a political fight ahead of coming state elections.

items.headline: Cabinet approves higher Rabi MSP and Rs 1.86 lakh crore green corridor
items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a package worth about Rs 2.79 lakh crore, including a higher Minimum Support Price for six Rabi crops for 2027-28 and a Rs 1.86 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor Phase-III to evacuate up to 135 GW of renewable power. The moves aim to support farm incomes and clean-energy infrastructure.

items.headline: Delhi to get Rs 1,789 crore AI-based traffic management system
items.summary: The Union Cabinet also cleared a Rs 1,789.52 crore Intelligent Traffic Management System for Delhi that will use real-time detection of congestion and accidents to help police respond faster. Variable message signs and digital platforms will alert commuters to diversions and parking availability.

items.headline: Maharashtra FDA cancels Cipla unit's licences, suspends 165 food outlets
items.summary: Maharashtra's FDA cancelled drug licences at a Cipla unit in Pune over the Reactin Plus recall and storage lapses, and separately suspended 165 food outlet licences after inspecting over 3,100 establishments. The action signals tighter regulatory enforcement on pharma and food safety in the state.

items.headline: Maharashtra's MPSC paper-leak probe uncovers full chain of events
items.summary: Investigators probing a leak of Maharashtra Public Service Commission exam papers have traced the chain from the creation of 294 questions through to their leak to students. The findings are expected to trigger disciplinary and possibly criminal action against those involved.

items.headline: Ghazipur encounter, UP draft voter list released same day
items.summary: Uttar Pradesh police exchanged fire with suspects during an encounter in Ghazipur, arresting two men from Punjab after being fired upon. Separately, the Election Commission released Uttar Pradesh's draft voter list following the Special Intensive Revision process, a step closely watched ahead of state polls.

items.headline: Sensex falls for fourth straight session, Nifty below 22,450
items.summary: The Sensex dropped 570.59 points, or 0.79%, to 71,909.70 while the Nifty50 fell 198.50 points to 22,421.95, extending losses to a fourth session. Bajaj Auto, Maruti Suzuki and Shriram Finance led the decline, with Nifty Auto among the weakest sectoral indices.

items.headline: Rupee slips to 96.11 against dollar as market mood turns cautious
items.summary: The rupee declined 14 paise to close at 96.11 against the US dollar, compared with Wednesday's close of 95.98, as equity weakness and global risk aversion weighed on sentiment. A weaker rupee adds to imported inflation pressure even as exporters see a marginal competitiveness boost.

items.headline: India's IPO market sets a September record despite stock selloff
items.summary: Indian companies raised more than 393 billion rupees ($4.1 billion) through 34 IPOs in September, a monthly record, while 46 firms filed draft papers for mainboard listings. The surge shows IPO demand holding up even as broader equity indices struggle.

items.headline: GST collections rise 14.7% to Rs 2.04 lakh crore in September
items.summary: India's gross GST collections climbed 14.7% year-on-year to nearly Rs 2.04 lakh crore in September, with a sharp rise in import-linked tax collections driving the gain. Net GST revenue after refunds rose 18.1% year-on-year, pointing to resilient consumption and trade activity.

items.headline: Stocks to watch: RIL, HDFC Bank, Infosys, IRFC, Blue Dart in focus
items.summary: Reliance Industries, NSE, HDFC Bank, IRFC, Infosys, Cupid and Blue Dart were among stocks in focus in Thursday's trade amid company-specific news flow and sector developments in oil marketing companies. The watchlist reflects a mix of earnings expectations and corporate-action triggers heading into the new quarter.

items.headline: IT stocks gain as Q2 FY27 earnings season approaches
items.summary: Shares of TCS, Infosys, HCLTech and Tech Mahindra rose as investors positioned ahead of the Q2 FY27 earnings season, with TCS set to report first on October 8, HCLTech on October 12 and Infosys on October 23. Analysts expect modest sequential revenue growth led by BFSI and hi-tech verticals.

items.headline: Oyo parent PRISM files updated IPO papers to raise Rs 6,650 crore
items.summary: Oyo's parent entity PRISM has filed updated draft papers with SEBI seeking to raise about Rs 6,650 crore through an initial public offering. The filing adds to a busy pipeline of Indian consumer-tech listings heading into the new fiscal year.

items.headline: JSW Cement to merge with listed unit Shiva Cement
items.summary: JSW Cement announced a merger with its listed subsidiary Shiva Cement, under which public shareholders will receive five JSW Cement shares for every 41 Shiva Cement shares held. The merger, expected to complete within 12-14 months, simplifies the group's cement holding structure.

items.headline: Oil prices jump over 2% as Brent tops $100 on China export curbs
items.summary: Brent crude jumped more than 2% to top $100 a barrel after reports that Chinese refiners suspended October fuel exports to protect domestic supply, adding to pressure from the US-Iran standoff and Russia's war in Ukraine. Higher crude raises input-cost risks for India, a major oil importer.

items.headline: Cabinet-backed Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0 gets Rs 10,000 crore corpus
items.summary: The government has moved to mobilise a fresh Rs 10,000 crore corpus for Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0, aimed at deepening venture-capital availability for India's startup ecosystem. The initiative comes as overall startup funding has cooled this year amid investor caution over West Asia tensions.

items.headline: Apple Pay launches in India with Axis Bank as first partner
items.summary: Apple has launched Apple Pay in India, initially available to Axis Bank cardholders on Visa and Mastercard networks, with no-cost EMIs and cashback offers on Apple product purchases. The launch opens India's large digital-payments market to Apple's wallet ecosystem for the first time.

items.headline: Samsung launches Galaxy Tab S12 series in India
items.summary: Samsung introduced the Galaxy Tab S12+ and Tab S12 Ultra in India, featuring a MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chip and 12GB RAM, with prices starting at Rs 1,29,999. The launch targets premium tablet buyers as Samsung expands its high-end device lineup in the Indian market.

items.headline: Dutch cyber-vulnerability institute hacked via AI-powered zero-day attack
items.summary: The Dutch Institute for Vulnerability Disclosure was breached using two zero-day flaws in the open-source Zammad ticketing platform, in what researchers describe as an AI-powered automated attack. The incident highlights the growing use of AI tools to accelerate real-world cyber intrusions against security organisations themselves.

items.headline: Xiaomi launches new Pro series phones with dual 200MP cameras
items.summary: Xiaomi unveiled its latest Pro-series smartphones featuring large batteries, dual 200MP camera setups and a rear display with a privacy feature that detects onlookers and shields the screen. The launch adds to a crowded festive-season lineup of premium Android devices in India.

items.headline: Google Fitbit Air spotted ahead of October India launch
items.summary: A Google Fitbit Air device has been spotted in Indian retail stores and listed on Flipkart at Rs 13,999 ahead of an expected October launch. The device marks Google's latest push into India's competitive wearables and fitness-tracking market.

items.headline: WHO issues guidance to prevent heat-related illness at mass gatherings
items.summary: The World Health Organization released new guidance for organisers of large public events to reduce heat-related illness risks, including monitoring protocols and emergency response planning. The guidance follows WHO's recent reviews of health risks tied to crowding and rising temperatures at major gatherings.

items.headline: ISRO rolls out Santulan nutrition programme for Gaganyaan astronauts
items.summary: ISRO has launched the Santulan programme for its Gaganyaan astronauts, offering personalised nutrition plans, expert diet monitoring and specialised catering ahead of India's first crewed spaceflight. The initiative is part of broader preparations supporting astronaut health and mission readiness.

items.headline: NASA invites India to join lunar south-pole base programme
items.summary: NASA has formally invited India to participate in its effort to build a permanent base near the Moon's south pole, deepening space cooperation between the two countries. The invitation builds on recent joint missions, including the NASA-ISRO NISAR Earth-observation satellite.

items.headline: India to face Pakistan in Asian Games men's cricket final
items.summary: World champions India will meet arch-rivals Pakistan for Asian Games cricket gold after both won their semi-finals comfortably on Thursday in Japan. India thrashed Sri Lanka by 124 runs, while Pakistan beat Bangladesh by six wickets in a match reduced to 13 overs by a wet outfield.

items.headline: Sri Lanka reach Asian Games semis as Nepal washed out by rain
items.summary: Sri Lanka advanced to the Asian Games cricket semi-finals without playing after their quarter-final against Nepal was abandoned due to persistent rain, with the higher-ranked side progressing under tournament rules. Sri Lanka's semi-final campaign ended with a heavy 124-run loss to India.

items.headline: Japan edge Uzbekistan on penalties to set up Asian Games football final
items.summary: Japan beat Uzbekistan 9-8 on penalties after a dramatic semi-final to reach the Asian Games men's football final, where they will face defending champions South Korea. South Korea reached the final with a 2-1 win over China, sealed by a stoppage-time winner.

items.headline: Argentina rout Bolivia 4-0, USA beat Chile in friendlies
items.summary: Argentina cruised to a 4-0 win over Bolivia while the United States defeated Chile 4-2 in international football friendlies, with Mexico held to a 1-1 draw by Peru. The results offer early form guides ahead of upcoming competitive fixtures for the South and North American sides.

items.headline: Mercedes' Antonelli holds commanding F1 points lead before Malaysian GP
items.summary: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli heads into this weekend's Malaysian Grand Prix at Sepang with a 66-point lead over rival Russell in the drivers' championship. Antonelli has been settling into the region ahead of the race as he looks to extend his advantage in the title fight.

items.headline: Barcelona thrash Roma 6-0 in Women's Champions League
items.summary: Barcelona Femeni crushed Roma Femminile 6-0 in the UEFA Women's Champions League, while Juventus Femminile beat Hacken Women 3-0 and Bayern Munich Ladies defeated Benfica Women 3-0 on a one-sided night across the competition. Paris FC were held 2-2 by Arsenal Women in the closest result of the round.

items.headline: St. Louis City thrash New York Red Bulls 3-0 in MLS
items.summary: St. Louis City SC beat New York Red Bulls 3-0 in Major League Soccer action, a result that boosts their push up the standings late in the season. The win adds to a mixed night across MLS fixtures as teams jockey for playoff positioning.
